comments.author: @robertcharpentier6852
comments.text: I lived in Hawaii for 37 years and was involved in real estate all that time.  One summer I hired a large private helicopter to take me and several of my friends on a trip around the Hawaiian Islands.  One of the last stops on our incredible one day journey around the states major islands the chopper landed on a remote beach in the northern part of the Island of Kauai.  There were several caves along the shore and it saw gigantic albatross birds sitting silently inside several of them.  StocktonRob

replies.text: Kauai's Napali cliffs by far and away. No comparison. I once took a Na pali boat ride to those jagged, GLARING green, intricate mountain formations. When I got back to my little motel in Hanalei I had to take a cold shower to mellow myself out!
